description: Implementation of the Sampler class for managing texture sampling state in OpenGL ES 3, including methods for setting and getting sampler parameters, state synchronization, and resource cleanup.

classes.name: gl::Sampler
classes.description: Represents a GLES 3 sampler object, managing its state and interaction with the underlying implementation.

methods.name: Sampler
methods.description: Constructor initializing the sampler with a factory and ID.

methods.description: Destructor cleaning up the sampler resource.

methods.description: Handles cleanup when the sampler is destroyed.
